# AIKDP — Practical AI Utilities

> Browser-only AI workflow tools for prompt building, prompt cleanup, token and cost estimates, and privacy checks before sending text to AI systems.

## Tools

- [AI Token & Cost Calculator](https://ai.kdp.cool/token-cost-calculator/): estimate input tokens, output tokens, and per-run cost for common AI API models using clearly labeled pricing assumptions.
- [Prompt Builder](https://ai.kdp.cool/prompt-builder/): turn a task, context, constraints, and output format into a structured prompt.
- [Prompt Cleaner](https://ai.kdp.cool/prompt-cleaner/): reorganize messy requirements into a clearer prompt format.
- [AI Privacy Checker](https://ai.kdp.cool/privacy-checker/): scan text locally for common sensitive patterns before pasting it into AI tools.
